title: Tantrasamgraha astronomy treatise
summary: Nilakantha Somayaji of the Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics completed a 432-verse Sanskrit treatise on astronomy.
why: Its planetary model resembled Tycho Brahe's later system, and some of its equations stayed the most accurate until Kepler.

notes.problem: 'Advanced mathematics centuries before similar European results' is not in the source; it only compares the model to Tycho's system and an equation to Kepler.
